# [pixi](../index.md) audit

Audit the lock file of the workspace for known vulnerabilities

--8<-- "docs/reference/cli/pixi/audit_extender:description"

## Usage
```
pixi audit [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]
```

## Subcommands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`ignore`](ignore.md) | Record ignore rules in the `[workspace.audit]` table of the manifest |


## Options
- <a id="arg---environment" href="#arg---environment">`--environment (-e) <ENVIRONMENT>`</a>
:  Audit only this environment (repeatable)
<br>May be provided more than once.
- <a id="arg---platform" href="#arg---platform">`--platform (-p) <PLATFORM>`</a>
:  Audit only this platform (repeatable)
<br>May be provided more than once.
- <a id="arg---ignore" href="#arg---ignore">`--ignore <ID>`</a>
:  Ignore this advisory id or alias, case-insensitively (repeatable). Added to the ignore rules of `[workspace.audit]`
<br>May be provided more than once.
- <a id="arg---ignore-until-fixed" href="#arg---ignore-until-fixed">`--ignore-until-fixed <ID>`</a>
:  Ignore this advisory id or alias while no fixed release newer than the locked version is reported in the package's own ecosystem (repeatable)
<br>May be provided more than once.
- <a id="arg---fail-on" href="#arg---fail-on">`--fail-on <SEVERITY>`</a>
:  Fail only for vulnerability matches at or above this severity. Matches with unknown severity always fail. Overrides `fail-on` of `[workspace.audit]`
- <a id="arg---warn-only-ecosystem" href="#arg---warn-only-ecosystem">`--warn-only-ecosystem <ECOSYSTEM>`</a>
:  Report vulnerability matches in this ecosystem without failing the audit (repeatable)
<br>May be provided more than once.
<br>**options**: `conda-forge`, `pypi`
- <a id="arg---fix" href="#arg---fix">`--fix`</a>
:  Update the lock file so that every vulnerability match passes the policy
- <a id="arg---json" href="#arg---json">`--json`</a>
:  Print the report as JSON (same as `--format json`)
- <a id="arg---format" href="#arg---format">`--format <FORMAT>`</a>
:  The format of the report on stdout
<br>**default**: `table`
<br>**options**: `table`, `by-package`, `json`, `sarif`
- <a id="arg---explain" href="#arg---explain">`--explain`</a>
:  Explain the terms and scoring of human-readable reports
- <a id="arg---sort-by" href="#arg---sort-by">`--sort-by <COLUMN>`</a>
:  The column to sort table rows by. Risk, severity, EPSS, and KEV sort highest first; other columns ascend
<br>**default**: `risk`
<br>**options**: `name`, `version`, `fixed-in`, `kind`, `source`, `vulnerability`, `severity`, `epss`, `risk`, `kev`, `environments`, `aliases`, `summary`, `url`, `ignored`, `confidence`
- <a id="arg---columns" href="#arg---columns">`--columns <COLUMNS>`</a>
:  The columns of the table, in order (comma-separated)
<br>May be provided more than once.
<br>**default**: `name, version, fixed-in, vulnerability, severity, epss, risk, environments`
<br>**options**: `name`, `version`, `fixed-in`, `kind`, `source`, `vulnerability`, `severity`, `epss`, `risk`, `kev`, `environments`, `aliases`, `summary`, `url`, `ignored`, `confidence`

## Config Options
- <a id="arg---no-config" href="#arg---no-config">`--no-config`</a>
:  Don't read system or user-level configuration files. Project-local `<project>/.pixi/config.toml` is still loaded
<br>**env**: `PIXI_NO_CONFIG`
<br>**default**: `false`
- <a id="arg---config-file" href="#arg---config-file">`--config-file <PATH>`</a>
:  Load configuration from this file instead of searching system and user-level paths. Project-local `<project>/.pixi/config.toml` is still merged on top
<br>**env**: `PIXI_CONFIG_FILE`
- <a id="arg---auth-file" href="#arg---auth-file">`--auth-file <AUTH_FILE>`</a>
:  Path to the file containing the authentication token
- <a id="arg---concurrent-downloads" href="#arg---concurrent-downloads">`--concurrent-downloads <CONCURRENT_DOWNLOADS>`</a>
:  Max concurrent network requests, default is `50`
- <a id="arg---concurrent-solves" href="#arg---concurrent-solves">`--concurrent-solves <CONCURRENT_SOLVES>`</a>
:  Max concurrent solves, default is the number of CPUs
- <a id="arg---pinning-strategy" href="#arg---pinning-strategy">`--pinning-strategy <PINNING_STRATEGY>`</a>
:  Set pinning strategy
<br>**options**: `semver`, `minor`, `major`, `latest-up`, `exact-version`, `no-pin`
- <a id="arg---pypi-keyring-provider" href="#arg---pypi-keyring-provider">`--pypi-keyring-provider <PYPI_KEYRING_PROVIDER>`</a>
:  Specifies whether to use the keyring to look up credentials for PyPI
<br>**options**: `disabled`, `subprocess`
- <a id="arg---run-post-link-scripts" href="#arg---run-post-link-scripts">`--run-post-link-scripts`</a>
:  Run post-link scripts (insecure)
- <a id="arg---no-symbolic-links" href="#arg---no-symbolic-links">`--no-symbolic-links`</a>
:  Disallow symbolic links during package installation
<br>**env**: `PIXI_NO_SYMBOLIC_LINKS`
- <a id="arg---no-hard-links" href="#arg---no-hard-links">`--no-hard-links`</a>
:  Disallow hard links during package installation
<br>**env**: `PIXI_NO_HARD_LINKS`
- <a id="arg---no-ref-links" href="#arg---no-ref-links">`--no-ref-links`</a>
:  Disallow ref links (copy-on-write) during package installation
<br>**env**: `PIXI_NO_REF_LINKS`
- <a id="arg---offline" href="#arg---offline">`--offline=<OFFLINE>`</a>
:  Run without network access, using only cached data. Commands fail if data is missing from the cache. Pass `--offline=false` to override an `offline` setting from the configuration
<br>**env**: `PIXI_OFFLINE`
<br>**options**: `y`, `yes`, `t`, `true`, `on`, `1`, `n`, `no`, `f`, `false`, `off`, `0`
- <a id="arg---tls-no-verify" href="#arg---tls-no-verify">`--tls-no-verify`</a>
:  Do not verify the TLS certificate of the server
- <a id="arg---tls-root-certs" href="#arg---tls-root-certs">`--tls-root-certs <TLS_ROOT_CERTS>`</a>
:  Which TLS root certificates to use: 'webpki' (bundled Mozilla roots) or 'system' (system store)
<br>**env**: `PIXI_TLS_ROOT_CERTS`
- <a id="arg---use-environment-activation-cache" href="#arg---use-environment-activation-cache">`--use-environment-activation-cache`</a>
:  Use environment activation cache (experimental)

## Global Options
- <a id="arg---manifest-path" href="#arg---manifest-path">`--manifest-path (-m) <MANIFEST_PATH>`</a>
:  The path to `pixi.toml`, `pyproject.toml`, or the workspace directory
- <a id="arg---workspace" href="#arg---workspace">`--workspace (-w) <WORKSPACE>`</a>
:  Name of the workspace

## Description
Audit the lock file of the workspace for known vulnerabilities.

Checks conda-forge packages with Basilisk and PyPI packages with OSV. Packages from other channels, private indexes, Git, or paths are listed as not audited. The audit never solves or installs; `--fix` solves once with temporary constraints and replaces the lock file only when every finding of the result passes the policy.

Exits with 1 when a vulnerability match fails the policy or the audit cannot complete.
